# Fox (glTF sample model)

Used as a real-world rigged, animated glTF asset (clips Survey, Walk, Run; joints named like
`b_RightHand_08`; authored in centimetre-scale units) to test that the engine is not tied to its own
generated assets.

Source: Khronos glTF Sample Assets, `Models/Fox/glTF-Binary/Fox.glb`
(https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Fox), unmodified.

- Model: PixelMannen, CC0 1.0
- Rigging & animation: tomkranis, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Conversion to glTF: @AsoboStudio and @scurest, CC BY 4.0

See `LICENSE.md` and `metadata.json` (copied from the source) for the full terms.
